name: Gath'Ilzogg
summary: Stonewatch Keep remains under Gath'Ilzogg's command in the Redridge Mountains. The Blackrock warlord's force holds the fortress and raids Lakeshire, where Magistrate Solomon has placed a bounty on him.

sections.title: The Scourge of Stonewatch
sections.body: Gath'Ilzogg came north from the Burning Steppes to secure Redridge for the Blackrock clan. With help from the renegade human warlock Morganth's foul sorcery, his warband battered Stonewatch Keep's defenders and seized the heights above the region. From the fortress, Gath'Ilzogg directs raids through the valleys and toward Lakeshire's bridge, tightening pressure on the human settlement. Elite Blackrock guards and a vicious black dragon whelp named Singe stay close to him.

sections.title: A Fragile Hold
sections.body: Gath'Ilzogg's hold on Stonewatch brought new dangers. Morganth turned against his former orcish allies and raised Shadowhide gnolls under Lieutenant Fangore. They prey on Blackrock patrols and human travelers alike. Magistrate Solomon has placed an open bounty on Gath'Ilzogg and calls on Alliance mercenaries or adventurers to climb Stonewatch Keep's ramparts and end his terror before Lakeshire falls entirely.

faq.answer: Gath'Ilzogg leads the Blackrock vanguard that invaded Redridge and captured Stonewatch Keep from the Alliance.
Gath'Ilzogg holds the top of Stonewatch Keep, in the eastern crags of the Redridge Mountains.

faq.q: Why does Gath'Ilzogg have a dragon whelp?
faq.answer: Gath'Ilzogg keeps a black dragon whelp named Singe at his side. Many believe Lord Victor Nefarius gave Singe to him for seizing Stonewatch Keep.

faq.q: Why is there a bounty on his head?
faq.answer: Magistrate Solomon of Lakeshire placed a high-priority bounty on Gath'Ilzogg because his raids and occupation of Stonewatch threaten the town with complete destruction.

faq.q: What happened between Gath'Ilzogg and Morganth?
faq.answer: Morganth, a human warlock, first aided Gath'Ilzogg's conquest of Stonewatch with dark magic. After the fortress fell, Morganth betrayed the orcs and raised Shadowhide gnolls to attack both humanity and the Blackrock clan.

angles.text: For the Alliance, defeating Gath'Ilzogg would break the backbone of the Blackrock offensive threatening Lakeshire and answer Magistrate Solomon's desperate call.
As an orc, Gath'Ilzogg shows the Blackrock clan's old, warmongering ways under the Dark Horde, wholly separate from Thrall's new Horde in Kalimdor.
